types.title: Note comment
types.description: Durable discussion context attached to one accessible note.

types.title: Note
types.description: A Markdown note in an accessible notebook.

types.title: Notebook
types.description: A permission-scoped collection of Markdown notes.

queries.title: Browse comment previews
queries.description: Select discussion context using short previews, newest first. Follow page.nextCursor; read the full text of any previewTruncated item with comment.read using ref.id.

noteId.description: Note ID returned by note search/tree/read or a notebooks.note ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

queries.title: List note comments
queries.description: List complete Markdown comments for one known note, newest first. A response may contain fewer than limit to fit the transport budget; always follow page.nextCursor. Prefer comment.browse to select comments before reading full bodies.

noteId.description: Note ID returned by note search/tree/read or a notebooks.note ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

queries.title: Read note comment
queries.description: Read one notebooks.comment ref returned by comment.list after checking access to its parent note.

id.description: Comment ID returned by comment.list or a notebooks.comment ref.

queries.title: Browse child notes
queries.description: Browse immediate children without loading the whole tree. Omit parentId for roots; otherwise use a note from the same notebook. Follow page.nextCursor, open a child with note.read, or use its ID as note.create parentId.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebook search/list/read or a notebooks.notebook ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

parentId.description: Parent note in this notebook; omit for root notes.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: List note links and backlinks
queries.description: List incoming or outgoing links after one note is known. Get noteId from a notebooks.note ref; inaccessible targets are omitted and returned note refs can be opened with note.read.

noteId.description: Note ID returned by note search/tree/read or a notebooks.note ref.

direction.description: Link direction relative to the selected note.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Check note blocks
queries.description: Validate query and TOC blocks using the same server preview as the editor. Returns compact diagnostics, not HTML or query rows. Requires a user-backed actor; saved content needs read access, drafts need write access. Does not save or validate all Markdown/table formulas.

noteId.description: Existing note ID returned by note.read, search or tree.

markdown.description: Complete draft Markdown, at most 200,000 characters. Omit for saved content. Drafts require write access and an unlocked note; nothing is saved.

queries.title: Read note
queries.description: Read one notebooks.note ref returned by note.search, note.tree, note.links, or tag.notes as a bounded Markdown window with hashes, tags, and named-block summaries. contentComplete means the entire source is present. Follow nextContentOffset while verifying contentHash is unchanged. Never replace a whole note with a partial window; prefer structural edits with ifContentHash.

id.description: Note ID returned by note search/tree/link/tag results or a notebooks.note ref.

contentOffset.description: Zero-based character offset into the Markdown source.

historyIncomplete.description: Some document history was unavailable during recovery; the content may be incomplete.

contentComplete.description: True only when this response contains the entire source, starting at offset zero. Never use a partial window as set-content.

queries.title: Search notes
queries.description: Direct cross-notebook entry for finding Markdown notes by title or content. Use returned notebooks.note refs with note.read; use note.tree to browse one known notebook without full-text search.

query.description: User-entered search text. Empty text is allowed when a facet narrows the query.

tags.description: Canonical search facets supported by this query.

scope.description: Optional resource containing the search results; must be an explicitly supported scope type.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

type.description: Namespaced resource type declared by the owning app.

priority.description: App-local relevance hint from zero to nine.

metadata.description: Small structured metadata shown with the result.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: List note tree
queries.description: Browse the hierarchy of one known notebook without loading Markdown. Get notebookId from notebook.list or notebook.search; use returned notebooks.note refs with note.read. Each response returns at most 100 entries even for a larger requested limit; follow page.nextCursor for the rest. Prefer note.children to choose a local parent.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebook search/list/read or a notebooks.notebook ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum lightweight tree entries to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Choose a notebook
queries.description: Compact notebook selection with effective permission and homepage. Use minimumPermission write before creating notes. Use returned ref.id with note.children or note.create; notebook.read is only needed for administrative details.

minimumPermission.description: Minimum effective permission required for returned notebooks.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: List notebooks
queries.description: Normal entry for notebook-scoped work. List accessible notebooks with effective permission; use returned notebooks.notebook refs or IDs with notebook.read, note.tree, tag.list, or note.create.

minimumPermission.description: Minimum effective permission required for returned notebooks.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Read notebook
queries.description: Read one notebooks.notebook ref returned by notebook.list or notebook.search, including its homepage note ID.

id.description: Notebook ID returned by notebook search/list or a notebooks.notebook ref.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: Search notebooks
queries.description: Find accessible notebooks by name or description when no notebook is known. Use returned notebooks.notebook refs with notebook.read or their IDs with note.tree and tag.list.

queries.title: List notebook tags
queries.description: List tags and note counts in one known notebook. Get notebookId from notebook.list or notebook.search; use a returned tag value with tag.notes.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebook search/list/read or a notebooks.notebook ref.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

rel.description: Semantic relationship; clients decide how to present it.

queries.title: List notes by tag
queries.description: List notes carrying one tag in a known notebook. Get notebookId from notebook.list and tag from tag.list; use returned notebooks.note refs with note.read.

notebookId.description: Notebook ID returned by notebook search/list/read or a notebooks.notebook ref.

tag.description: Notebook tag without the leading hash sign.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor returned by the previous page.

actions.title: Add note comment
actions.description: Add Markdown discussion context to one writable note as the current user.

noteId.description: Writable note ID returned by note search/tree/read or a notebooks.note ref.

actions.title: Delete note comment
actions.description: Delete the current user's own comment within ten minutes of creation. Requires write access to the notebook.

commentId.description: Own comment ID returned by comment.list or comment.read; deletable for ten minutes after creation.

actions.title: Edit note comment
actions.description: Replace the current user's own comment within ten minutes of creation. Requires write access to the notebook.

commentId.description: Own comment ID returned by comment.list or comment.read; editable for ten minutes after creation.

content.description: Replacement Markdown comment, limited to 5,000 characters.

position.description: Optional sibling position; defaults to append.

content.description: Initial Markdown source; a title is derived or generated by the notebook.
